subject.title: fix(shared): re-throw non-ENOENT errors in ignore-rules file reads

question: Should an unreadable ignore file abort both skill discovery and session package scanning, or should either caller recover with an explicit warning?
rationale: The patch intentionally replaces a permissive fallback with fail-closed behavior across two user-facing discovery paths, and code correctness alone cannot determine that compatibility policy.

options.title: Fail closed with diagnostics
options.body: Abort on every non-ENOENT failure, add caller-level diagnostics and coverage, and provide a clear operator recovery path.

options.title: Warn and continue
options.body: Preserve discovery availability by warning and skipping the unreadable ignore file, accepting that additional files may enter scan results.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with diagnostics
recommendation.body: Abort on every non-ENOENT failure, add caller-level diagnostics and coverage, and provide a clear operator recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this contributor to both predecessor caller surfaces, although the exact extraction owner remains uncertain.
